claims.claim: France 24 reports Ukraine launched an overnight drone attack on Moscow that Russian authorities described on Tuesday as involving 650 drones and killing a man.
claims.episode_span: France 24 reports that Ukraine launched an overnight drone attack on Moscow
claims.source_title: Ukraine hits Moscow with one of its largest drone attacks in two years
claims.supporting_quote: A massive attack involving 650 drones targeted Moscow overnight, killing a man, Russian authorities said Tuesday.

claims.claim: TASS said the attack was the second-largest drone attack on Moscow and its surrounding region in two years.
claims.episode_span: the second-largest drone attack on Moscow and the surrounding region
claims.source_title: Ukraine hits Moscow with one of its largest drone attacks in two years
claims.supporting_quote: According to the Russian state news agency TASS, the pummelling was the second-largest drone attack on the Russian capital and its surrounding region in the past two years.

claims.claim: Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said Russia downed most of 650 drones, of which 105 were downed close to the city.
claims.episode_span: Russia downed most of the 650 drones sent toward the capital, including 105 downed close to the city
claims.source_title: Ukraine hits Moscow with one of its largest drone attacks in two years
claims.supporting_quote: Moscow Mayor ‌Sergei Sobyanin said ‌that Russia ​downed most of the 650 drones launched towards ​the capital ​overnight, of ​which 105 drones ​were downed close to the city itself.

claims.claim: Governor Andrei Vorobyov said a 20-year-old man was killed on the outskirts of Moscow and several homes were damaged.
claims.episode_span: a 20-year-old man was killed in a village on the outskirts and that several homes were damaged
claims.source_title: Ukraine hits Moscow with one of its largest drone attacks in two years
claims.supporting_quote: The attack killed a 20-year-old man in a village on the outskirts of Moscow, regional governor Andrei Vorobyov said, adding that several homes were damaged.

claims.claim: Ria Novosti reported six people were wounded.
claims.source_title: Ukraine hits Moscow with one of its largest drone attacks in two years
claims.supporting_quote: The strikes wounded six people, Ria Novosti news agency reported.

claims.claim: Russia has said it plans to increase strikes on infrastructure targets, including in Kyiv, as winter approaches.

claims.supporting_quote: Russia has said it plans to increase strikes on infrastructure targets, including in Kyiv , as winter approaches.

claims.claim: The European Commission concluded Poland cannot disburse about €26 million, or PLN 116 million, for a MAN Trucks factory expansion in Niepołomice because the aid is incompatible with EU state-aid rules.
claims.source_title: Commission finds Polish support for MAN Trucks factory expansion incompatible State aid
claims.supporting_quote: Therefore, Poland cannot disburse the aid.

claims.claim: The Commission said Poland failed to prove the aid was decisive for locating the investment in Poland and did not show it was the minimum necessary.
claims.episode_span: Poland had not proved the aid decided MAN Trucks’ choice of Poland
claims.source_title: Commission finds Polish support for MAN Trucks factory expansion incompatible State aid
claims.supporting_quote: Based on its in-depth investigation, the Commission has now concluded that Poland failed to prove that the aid was decisive for MAN Trucks to locate its investment in Poland, which is a requirement under the RAG.

claims.claim: On 6 October 2026 the UK government said it will accept all 44 recommendations of the National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare, published on 10 September.
claims.source_title: Government backs recommendations of NHS doctors-led AI Commission
claims.supporting_quote: The government has today, 6 October 2026, confirmed it will accept all 44 recommendations made by the National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare, published 10 September, and has set out how they will be delivered across the UK.

claims.claim: The MHRA opened applications for phase three of AI Airlock, with a webinar on 22 October, and committed to draft guidance by December 2026 and a consultation next year on qualifying and classifying AI devices.
claims.episode_span: the MHRA opened applications for phase three of AI Airlock
claims.source_title: Government backs recommendations of NHS doctors-led AI Commission
claims.supporting_quote: Alongside the response, the MHRA is opening the call for applications for the third phase of AI Airlock, its regulatory sandbox for AI-enabled medical devices, with testing themes directly informed by the Commission’s recommendations.

claims.claim: Norwegian F-35s identified 107 Russian military aircraft by 29 September after 77 scrambles, compared with 53 identified in all of last year, and NATO airspace was not violated.
claims.episode_span: identified 107 Russian military aircraft by 29 September, against 53 in all of last year, after 77 scrambles
claims.supporting_quote: A total of 53 Russian military aircraft were identified last year, while 107 had been identified after Norwegian F35s were sent out 77 times by September 29.

claims.claim: After Sunday’s general election in Bosnia, the SDA, HDZ BiH and SNSD each remained the strongest force in their ethnic camps, and turnout was a record low.
claims.episode_span: each remained the strongest force in their ethnic camp, on a record low turnout
claims.source_title: Nationalist Parties Celebrate Wins in Bosnia Election, But Many Voters Stay Home
claims.supporting_quote: The [Bosniak] Party of Democratic Action, SDA, the Croatian Democratic Union, HDZ BiH, and the [Serb] Alliance of Independent Social Democrats, SNSD, each remained the strongest force in their respective ethnic camps, while many voters stayed at home

claims.claim: Thousands marched in Barcelona on Monday; some threw objects and set bins on fire; police detained several people; Spain’s government has called a snap election for 29 November.

claims.source_title: Housing protest turns violent in Barcelona with fires and arrests
claims.supporting_quote: Thousands of people marched through central Barcelona on Monday to demand affordable homes, carrying banners and chanting for free and quality housing.

claims.claim: Marta Kos said the EU must not let in Trojan horses and that safeguards are a must-have.

claims.source_title: As Ukraine Pushes, EU Weighs How to Absorb New Members
claims.supporting_quote: “We must make sure we do not let in Trojan horses,” EU enlargement commissioner Marta Kos said in August.

claims.claim: Friedrich Merz floated associate membership allowing attendance without a vote, and Ukraine and a raft of EU countries gave the plan short shrift.

claims.source_title: As Ukraine Pushes, EU Weighs How to Absorb New Members
claims.supporting_quote: That plan received short shrift from a raft of EU countries and Ukraine, who saw it as a way of trapping wannabe members in a permanent halfway house.

claims.claim: Montenegro is pressing to become the EU’s 28th member next year, with Albania not far behind, and Ukraine and Moldova are among four frontrunners.
